mapper.select: /** managerrequest-mapper.getManagerByLoginId (관리자 조회 - 로그인 아이디 기준) */ SELECT A.USER_ID ,LOGIN_ID AS LOGIN_ID ,A.PASSWORD ,USER_NAME AS USER_NAME ,EMAIL AS EMAIL ,PHONE_NUMBER AS PHONE_NUMBER ,A.STATUS_CODE ,A.LOGIN_COUNT ,A.LOGIN_DATE ,A.DENY_DATE ,A.LEAVE_DATE ,A.LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT ,A.LOGIN_TRY_DATE ,A.PASSWORD_TYPE ,A.PASSWORD_EXPIRED_DATE ,A.AUTH_EXPIRED_DATE ,A.UPDATED_DATE ,A.CREATED_DATE ,A.LOCGOV_CODE ,A.BANK_CODE FROM ( SELECT M.USER_ID, M.LOGIN_ID, M.PASSWORD, M.USER_NAME, M.EMAIL, M.PHONE_NUMBER, M.STATUS_CODE, M.LOGIN_COUNT, M.LOGIN_DATE, M.DENY_DATE, M.LEAVE_DATE, M.LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT, M.LOGIN_TRY_DATE, M.PASSWORD_TYPE, M.PASSWORD_EXPIRED_DATE, M.AUTH_EXPIRED_DATE, M.UPDATED_DATE, M.CREATED_DATE, M.LOCGOV_CODE, M.BANK_CODE FROM OP_MANAGER M WHERE M.LOGIN_ID = #{value} ) A
mapper.insert:
/** managerrequest-mapper.insertManagerRequest (관리자 신청 등록) */ INSERT G_MNGR_REQST ( USER_ID, REQST_SN, LOGIN_ID, LOCGOV_CODE, REQST_SE_CODE, PSITN_CODE, PSITN_NM, PSITN_DEPT_NM, OFCPS_NM, CTTPC, CONFM_STTUS_CODE, REJECT_RESN, FRST_REGISTER_ID, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM ) VALUES ( #{userId}, (SELECT IFNULL(MAX(REQST_SN), 0)+1 FROM G_MNGR_REQST WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}), #{loginId}, #{locgovCode}, #{reqstSeCode}, #{psitnCode}, #{psitnNm}, #{psitnDeptNm}, #{ofcpsNm}, #{cttpc}, #{confmSttusCode}, #{rejectResn}, #{frstRegisterId}, , #{lastUpdusrId},
)
mapper.select: /** managerrequest-mapper.getManagerRequestCountByParam (관리자 권한 승인관리 목록 갯수 조회) */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM G_MNGR_REQST R INNER JOIN OP_USER U ON U.USER_ID = R.USER_ID INNER JOIN OP_USER_DETAIL UD ON UD.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C1 ON C1.CODE_TYPE = 'CFM_STATUS' AND C1.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C1.LANGUAGE = 'ko' AND C1.ID = R.CONFM_STTUS_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C2 ON C2.CODE_TYPE = 'REQST_SE_CODE' AND C2.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C2.LANGUAGE = 'ko' AND C2.ID = R.REQST_SE_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C3 ON C3.CODE_TYPE = 'LOCGOV_CODE' AND C3.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C3.LANGUAGE = 'ko' AND C3.ID = R.LOCGOV_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C4 ON C4.CODE_TYPE = 'WDR' AND C4.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C4.LANGUAGE = 'ko' AND C4.ID = CONCAT(SUBSTR(R.LOCGOV_CODE, 1, 2), '000') LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C5 ON C5.CODE_TYPE = 'OFF_BANK_LIST' AND C5.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C5.LANGUAGE = 'ko' AND C5.ID = R.PSITN_CODE

/** managerrequest-mapper.getManagerRequestDetails (관리자 권한 승인관리 상세 조회) */ SELECT A.USER_ID ,A.REQST_SN ,LOGIN_ID AS LOGIN_ID ,A.LOCGOV_CODE ,A.REQST_SE_CODE ,A.PSITN_CODE ,A.PSITN_NM ,A.PSITN_DEPT_NM ,OFCPS_NM AS OFCPS_NM ,CTTPC AS CTTPC ,A.CONFM_STTUS_CODE ,A.REJECT_RESN ,A.FRST_REGISTER_ID ,A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM ,A.LAST_UPDUSR_ID ,A.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM ,USER_NAME AS USER_NAME ,EMAIL AS EMAIL ,PHONE_NUMBER AS PHONE_NUMBER ,BIRTHDAY AS BIRTHDAY ,A.RECEIVE_EMAIL ,A.CONFM_STTUS_NM ,A.REQST_SE_NM ,A.LOCGOV_NM ,A.UPPER_LOCGOV_NM ,A.BANK_NM ,A.UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE FROM ( SELECT R.USER_ID, R.REQST_SN, R.LOGIN_ID, R.LOCGOV_CODE, R.REQST_SE_CODE, R.PSITN_CODE, R.PSITN_NM, R.PSITN_DEPT_NM, R.OFCPS_NM, R.CTTPC, R.CONFM_STTUS_CODE, R.REJECT_RESN, R.FRST_REGISTER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(R.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM,'%Y-%m-%d') AS FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, R.LAST_UPDUSR_ID, DATE_FORMAT(R.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM,'%Y-%m-%d') AS LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, U.USER_NAME, U.EMAIL, UD.PHONE_NUMBER, UD.BIRTHDAY, UD.RECEIVE_EMAIL, C1.LABEL AS CONFM_STTUS_NM, C2.LABEL AS REQST_SE_NM, C3.LABEL AS LOCGOV_NM, C4.LABEL AS UPPER_LOCGOV_NM, C5.LABEL AS BANK_NM, CONCAT(SUBSTR(R.LOCGOV_CODE, 1, 2), '000') AS UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE FROM G_MNGR_REQST R INNER JOIN OP_USER U ON U.USER_ID = R.USER_ID INNER JOIN OP_USER_DETAIL UD ON UD.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C1 ON C1.CODE_TYPE = 'CFM_STATUS' AND C1.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C1.LANGUAGE = 'ko' AND C1.ID = R.CONFM_STTUS_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C2 ON C2.CODE_TYPE = 'REQST_SE_CODE' AND C2.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C2.LANGUAGE = 'ko' AND C2.ID = R.REQST_SE_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C3 ON C3.CODE_TYPE = 'LOCGOV_CODE' AND C3.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C3.LANGUAGE = 'ko' AND C3.ID = R.LOCGOV_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C4 ON C4.CODE_TYPE = 'WDR' AND C4.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C4.LANGUAGE = 'ko' AND C4.ID = CONCAT(SUBSTR(R.LOCGOV_CODE, 1, 2), '000') LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C5 ON C5.CODE_TYPE = 'OFF_BANK_LIST' AND C5.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C5.LANGUAGE = 'ko' AND C5.ID = R.PSITN_CODE WHERE R.USER_ID = #{userId} AND R.REQST_SN = #{reqstSn} ) A

/** managerrequest-mapper.getManagerRequestHistory (관리자 권한 승인관리 이력 조회) */ SELECT A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM ,A.REQST_SE_CODE ,A.REQST_SE_NM ,A.CONFM_STTUS_NM ,A.UPD_ID_ROLE ,A.LOGIN_ID ,A.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(R.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM,'%Y-%m-%d') AS FRST_REGIST_PNTTM ,REQST_SE_CODE ,( CASE WHEN R.REQST_SE_CODE = 'ROLE_ADMIN_6' THEN CONCAT(C4.LABEL, '', C3.LABEL) ELSE C2.LABEL END ) AS REQST_SE_NM ,C1.LABEL AS CONFM_STTUS_NM ,( SELECT ROLE_NAME FROM OP_ROLE OROLE INNER JOIN OP_USER_ROLE OUR ON OROLE.AUTHORITY = OUR.AUTHORITY AND OUR.AUTHORITY LIKE 'ROLE_ADMIN%' WHERE OUR.USER_ID = R.LAST_UPDUSR_ID AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS UPD_ID_ROLE ,( CASE WHEN R.CONFM_STTUS_CODE != '200' THEN U.LOGIN_ID ELSE NULL END) AS LOGIN_ID ,DATE_FORMAT(R.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM ,'%Y-%m-%d') AS LAST_UPDT_PNTTM FROM G_MNGR_REQST R INNER JOIN OP_USER U ON U.USER_ID = R.last_updusr_id INNER JOIN OP_USER_DETAIL UD ON UD.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C1 ON C1.CODE_TYPE = 'CFM_STATUS' AND C1.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C1.LANGUAGE = 'ko' AND C1.ID = R.CONFM_STTUS_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C2 ON C2.CODE_TYPE = 'REQST_SE_CODE' AND C2.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C2.LANGUAGE = 'ko' AND C2.ID = R.REQST_SE_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C3 ON C3.CODE_TYPE = 'LOCGOV_CODE' AND C3.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C3.LANGUAGE = 'ko' AND C3.ID = R.LOCGOV_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C4 ON C4.CODE_TYPE = 'WDR' AND C4.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C4.LANGUAGE = 'ko' AND C4.ID = CONCAT(SUBSTR(R.LOCGOV_CODE, 1, 2), '000') LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C5 ON C5.CODE_TYPE = 'OFF_BANK_LIST' AND C5.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C5.LANGUAGE = 'ko' AND C5.ID = R.PSITN_CODE WHERE R.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY R.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM DESC ) A
mapper.insert:
/** managerrequest-mapper.insertManagerByUserSync (관리자 등록 - 사용자 정보 동기화) */ INSERT INTO OP_MANAGER ( USER_ID, LOGIN_ID, PASSWORD, USER_NAME, EMAIL, PHONE_NUMBER, STATUS_CODE, LOGIN_COUNT, LOGIN_DATE, DENY_DATE, LEAVE_DATE, LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT, LOGIN_TRY_DATE, PASSWORD_TYPE, PASSWORD_EXPIRED_DATE, AUTH_EXPIRED_DATE, UPDATED_DATE, CREATED_DATE, LOCGOV_CODE, BANK_CODE, EMP_ID, PSITN_NM, PSITN_DEPT_NM, OFCPS_NM, INFO_UPDT_DE ) SELECT U.USER_ID, U.LOGIN_ID, U.PASSWORD, U.USER_NAME, U.EMAIL, (SELECT UD.PHONE_NUMBER FROM OP_USER_DETAIL UD WHERE UD.USER_ID = #{userId} AND UD.USE_FLAG = 'Y'), U.STATUS_CODE, 0, U.LOGIN_DATE, U.DENY_DATE, U.LEAVE_DATE, 0, U.LOGIN_TRY_DATE, U.PASSWORD_TYPE, U.PASSWORD_EXPIRED_DATE, NULL, , , R.LOCGOV_CODE, R.PSITN_CODE, NULL, R.PSITN_NM, R.PSITN_DEPT_NM, R.OFCPS_NM,
FROM OP_USER U INNER JOIN G_MNGR_REQST R ON R.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND R.REQST_SN = #{reqstSn} WHERE U.USER_ID = #{userId} AND U.STATUS_CODE = 9
mapper.select: /** managerrequest-mapper.getPasswordChangeTypeByUserId (비밀번호 변경 타입 조회) */ SELECT CASE WHEN IFNULL(M.INFO_UPDT_DE, '') = '' AND M.PASSWORD_TYPE = 'T' THEN 'PASS_CHANGE_F' WHEN M.PASSWORD_TYPE = 'T' THEN 'PASS_CHANGE_I' WHEN DATEDIFF(DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(M.PASSWORD_EXPIRED_DATE, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), NOW()) < 1 THEN 'PASS_CHANGE_C' ELSE '' END FROM OP_MANAGER M WHERE M.STATUS_CODE = 9 AND M.USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.update: /** managerrequest-mapper.updateManagerLoginFailCount (로그인 실패 카운트 증가) */ UPDATE OP_MANAGER SET LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT = IFNULL(LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT, 0) + 1 WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select: /** managerrequest-mapper.getUserInfoByLoginId (회원 정보 조회) */ SELECT A.USER_ID ,A.PASSWORD ,LOGIN_ID AS LOGIN_ID ,USER_NAME AS USER_NAME ,EMAIL AS EMAIL ,PHONE_NUMBER AS PHONE_NUMBER ,BIRTHDAY AS BIRTHDAY FROM ( SELECT U.USER_ID, U.PASSWORD, U.LOGIN_ID, U.USER_NAME, U.EMAIL, UD.PHONE_NUMBER, UD.BIRTHDAY FROM OP_USER U INNER JOIN OP_USER_DETAIL UD ON U.USER_ID = UD.USER_ID WHERE U.LOGIN_ID = #{loginId} )A
/** managerrequest-mapper.getUserRole (사용자 권한 확인) */ SELECT OM.USER_ID ,OUR.AUTHORITY FROM OP_MANAGER OM INNER JOIN OP_USER_ROLE OUR ON OM.USER_ID = OUR.USER_ID WHERE OM.USER_ID = #{userId}
